text: This report recommends that City Council approve the alterations proposed for the designated heritage properties at 220 Cowan Avenue and 1313 Queen Street West under Section 33 of the Ontario Heritage Act in connection with a proposed development of the subject properties as part of the City-led Parkdale Hub project. The subject heritage properties are located at the southwest corner of the intersection of Queen Street West and Cowan Avenue within the Parkdale Main Street Heritage Conservation District (the "HCD"). The HCD was approved by City Council but is currently under appeal to the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT) and is not in effect.
